tools.name: find_similar_days
tools.description: Days since 1990 when the 14 sensors of the crisis meter, market-top risk and recession risk stood closest to a given day (default: today), at least half a year apart and at least a year before the given day, and what followed within 12 months: the crisis meter peak, a US recession (NBER), an S&P 500

tools.name: what_to_watch
tools.description: How many points each instrument is from the next zone boundary up or down, which sensors are closest to switching on or off (threshold 80), and the freshest and stalest inputs. Use for "what would change the picture?".

tools.name: get_expectations
tools.description: What markets price now (Fed rate path from the 2-year Treasury yield, 5-year breakeven inflation, yields) and what happened over the next 12 months after the 10 days since 1990 most similar to today (same 14 sensors as find_similar_days, at least half a year apart), with the number of distinct cycle

tools.name: get_monthly_history
tools.description: Monthly averages of one or several instruments between two months (DSI since 2006, the others since 1990), with the zone of each month: dollar index, crisis meter, market shock, market anomalies, market-top and recession risk. Use for trends and to see what the instruments showed around past events.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: How Isoba behaved when run point-in-time over every working day since 1990 (only data published by each day, checked for look-ahead).
